long_biography.plain_text:
Jones began his working life as a musician and built a music-design business before turning to internet infrastructure. In 1999 he and Gail Jones established UKFast in Manchester. The company developed managed hosting, cloud and colocation services, invested in its own data-centre estate and expanded into cybersecurity, serving thousands of business and public-sector customers.

Jones coupled strategic growth with a highly visible founder-led culture, adding property and hospitality ventures around the technology group. Private-equity investment preceded his resignation as chief executive and the founders' subsequent final exit. In 2023, a court convicted him of two rapes and a sexual assault and imposed a 15-year prison sentence; his MBE was subsequently annulled.
